annotations.title: Replace a TikTok automated rule’s definition

description: Replace an automated rule’s WHOLE definition. TikTok’s update is a full replace rather than a patch, so send every field the rule should keep — anything omitted is gone. IF THE RULE IS CURRENTLY RUNNING AND THE NEW VERSION CAN START OR RAISE SPEND, this arms it the moment it saves, so it takes the same confirm:true plus confirmScope echo as arming one: an edit must never be a route by which a harmless rule becomes a spending rule behind a gate it passed when it meant something else. A rule that is currently OFF needs no gate here, because arming it later runs the gate against the new definition. Free.

actions.description: what the rule does on a match; replaces the existing actions

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

conditions.description: when the rule fires; replaces the existing conditions

confirm.description: required when the rule is live and the new version can spend

confirmScope.description: required in the same case — the scope token the refusal prints, computed from the version being sent

name.description: rule name; the update replaces the whole rule, so send the name again

notification.description: notification settings object (notificationType, emailSetting); replaces the existing one

ruleExecInfo.description: run schedule object (execTimeType, execTime, timePeriodInfo); replaces the existing one

tzone.description: timezone for the rule's time windows, sent to TikTok as given
